description: This file defines the Store controller class within the OpenCart admin setting module. It manages CRUD operations for store settings, including listing stores, rendering store forms, saving, deleting, and rebuilding store data.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store configurations within the OpenCart admin panel, handling listing, editing, saving, deleting, and rebuilding store data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the store list page, setting up page data and rendering the store view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Responds with the list of stores, typically used for AJAX or internal calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML or data for the list of stores, with pagination support.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a store, populating data with existing store info if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a store, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected stores after permission and dependency checks, responding with success or error messages.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds store data, typically resetting or regenerating store configurations.
